name: znetwork_dplay_destroy_cached_local_player
description: zNetwork_DPlay_DestroyCachedLocalPlayer destroys the cached DirectPlay local player when one exists and reports DirectPlay failures.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The DirectPlay call is verified through the native fake IDirectPlay4 vtable rather than a live DirectPlay session.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x48a980 show an early return 0 when g_zNetwork_LocalPlayerRecord is null, an IDirectPlay4 vtable call through slot 0x24 using g_zNetwork_pDirectPlay4 and the cached record's playerKey, return 1 for non-negative HRESULTs, and zNetwork_DPlay::ReportError(hresult, znet_dplay.cpp, 0x1ba) for negative HRESULTs.

The dependency frontier for 0x48a980 has no visible source blockers; zNetwork_DPlay::ReportError is an accepted functional dependency and the indirect call is the recovered IDirectPlay4::DestroyPlayer provider slot.
The native smoke verifies the null-player return, successful DestroyPlayer dispatch with the cached key, and negative-HRESULT error path.
